def sumTo : Nat → Nat

theorem sumTo_eq (n : Nat) : 2 * sumTo n = n * (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [sumTo, Nat.mul_add]
    rw [ih]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one]
